items.title: MECH-322 sleep-replay carve-out: confirmatory evidence-purpose safety + survival confirmer

items.title: ARC-030/MECH-307 G0 readiness: re-run 866a scaffolded config with MECH-307 genuinely ON (A/B), confirm G0 before discriminative retest
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC READINESS GATE for ARC-030's COMBINED-vs-NOGO_ONLY discriminative retest (claim_ids=[] -- tags NO claim as evidence; GATES ARC-030[primary]/Q-021/INV-034, named in gates_claims). Re-runs V3-EXQ-866a's FULL scaffolded_sd054_onboarding config as a MECH-307 A/B: FULL_M307_ON vs FULL_M307_OFF vs RANDOM, seeds 42/43/44. WHY: MECH-307 was UNREACHABLE via REEConfig.from_dims() until d63f13b7 (all 12 params dropped into **kwargs), so 603q/866a/866b -- ARC-030's whole scaffolded lineage -- ran with MECH-307 entirely OFF (evidence/planning/mech307_from_dims_unreachable_2026-08-07.md). That from_dims fix is now landed; MECH-307 is genuinely reachable for the FIRST time. Before ARC-030's retest can be queued, the shared G0 non-degeneracy precondition must be shown to clear on the substrate MECH-307 is actually on -- NOT a formality: 866a already FAILED G0 with MECH-307 off (FULL rvr 0.0033 < RANDOM 0.0103) and z_goal decayed to a P2 mean 0.12 (< 0.4 C6 floor); 866b (PASS) confirmed the substrate is sound, localising the gap to the hazard-only curriculum stages. ROUTING (diagnostic, weights no governance score): preconditions-unmet -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; G0_ON pass -> readiness_pass_arc030_retest_unblocked (then queue ARC-030's COMBINED-vs-NOGO_ONLY per its what_would_answer); G0_ON fail -> readiness_fail_curriculum_gate_blocks_retest (route to substrate_queue stub 'scaffolded-curriculum-hazard-rebalance' FIRST, then re-run this gate; do NOT force the retest). The FULL_M307_OFF arm reproduces 866a in-harness so the G0 delta is attributable to MECH-307; if OFF would clear G0 while ON fails, mech307_perturbs_baseline is flagged (MECH-307-on, though mechanically correct, degrades this baseline). INTERACTION: shares the G0 gate with the hazard-rebalance stub (Q-021/INV-034/ARC-030). If that curriculum fix lands first, re-evaluate what 'G0 clears' means here before the retest. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = FULL_M307_ON transition-type resource_visit_rate vs RANDOM WITH MECH-307 genuinely on -- recorded in NO existing manifest (every scaffolded run to date had MECH-307 silently off); not recoverable -> run.
